brief:
Cardinal Pierbattista Pizzaballa, Latin Patriarch of Jerusalem, participated in a meeting convened by Pope Leo XIV in Rome, according to the Latin Patriarchate of Jerusalem. The gathering marked the tenth anniversary of Amoris laetitia, the papal document on marriage and family life.

The meeting aimed to renew and deepen the Church's discussion on marriage doctrine a decade after the document's release.
